falsifier: Three independent falsifiers, all cheap. (1) CONSTANT-ARM CLAUSE: exhibit a `v = (<expr> == K);` with both results constant that compiles to a conditional branch pair rather than to the branchless `subfic`/`cntlzw`/`srwi.` (or `subfe`/`addze`) idiom under MWCC GC 1.2.5 at this project's flags - one sighting disproves it. (2) SUB-KIND CLAUSE: exhibit a one-case switch carrier that reproduces a `bcc ->(addr+8)` + `b` terminator whose FALSE edge lands on a join block that is immediately consumed by a compare of the assigned variable; or, conversely, a site whose false edge is a RETURN block where the one-case switch fails to reproduce the pair. The supporting measurements are attempt.WS_writegauntletsave-switch-producer-verified-hoist-hypothesis-refuted.20260901.v2 (return-block site, switch reproduces the target region instruction-for-instruction) and attempt.WS_get-vmu-directory-branch-pair-two-more-carriers-dead.20260901.v3 (join-block site, the same switch carrier regressed 3t->5t in v2's G4, and G5/G6 failed as described). (3) ORACLE-COUNT CLAUSE: re-run `python tools/gdl/composed_census/ws_unfused_branch_census.py branch` after a full ninja; if the oracle population is not 271 sites in 193 byte-exact functions, the census premise this law leans on has moved and the law should be re-derived.
subject: tu:game/sys/memcard
value:
MWCC GC 1.2.5 family, measured on game/sys/memcard. This REFINES claim.law.GW_unfused-conditional-over-branch-is-a-conditional-EXPRESSION-tell.20260901.v1 by supplying the boundary its producer set lacks. The GW law is right that `bcc ->(addr+8)` followed by an unconditional `b` is a conditional-EXPRESSION tell; what it does not say is that the producer set is NOT interchangeable, and picking the wrong member costs a build every time.

CLAUSE 1 - A COMPARISON ASSIGNED TO A VARIABLE IS ONLY A PRODUCER WHEN AN ARM IS NON-CONSTANT. `success = (f() == 1);` does NOT emit a branch pair: MWCC lowers a two-constant-arm boolean to the BRANCHLESS idiom and the guard disappears entirely. MEASURED (get_vmu_directory, probe G5): replacing `if ((u8) beginSaveCacheTransaction() != 1) { success = 0; }` with `success = ((u8) beginSaveCacheTransaction() == 1);` replaced the target's five-word `cmplwi / bne / b / li / cmpwi` block with a three-word `subfic / cntlzw / srwi.`, taking the multiset from 3t to 8t and the instruction count from O115 to O114. Denying the branchless form by making one arm a variable (`... ? success : 0`, probe G6) DOES restore a branch - confirming the mechanism - but costs an extra `li` because the target's true arm leaves the register alone. So: constant-vs-constant selects branchless; variable-vs-constant selects a branch that materializes on both paths; neither is the target's shape when the target's true arm is a no-op.

CLAUSE 2 - THE CARRIER IS SELECTED BY WHAT THE TWO EDGES LAND ON, NOT BY HOW THE GUARD IS SPELLED. Two sites in ONE translation unit, same flags, same tell, opposite answers:
  RETURN-BLOCK sub-kind (writeGauntletSave @0xe4): the false edge lands in `li r3,0; b epilogue`. A ONE-CASE SWITCH - `switch (f()) { case 0: <body> break; default: return 0; }` - reproduces the target's `cmpwi / beq ->+8 / b / <body> / b / li / b` region instruction-for-instruction (verified in the aligned view; function multiset 7t -> 4t). This is the natural lowering of a switch dispatch chain: compare-and-branch-to-case, then an unconditional branch to default.
  JOIN-BLOCK sub-kind (get_vmu_directory @0x48): the false edge lands on a join immediately consumed by `cmpwi r30,0`. The SAME one-case switch carrier REGRESSES there (3t -> 5t), as do the arm-swap, the comparison-assignment and the variable-arm ternary - four carriers, four distinct failure modes. This is the operative form of claim.law.NV_ternary-cure-fails-when-branch-pair-target-is-a-join-block.20260901.v1, generalized past the ternary to the whole carrier dictionary.
PRACTICAL RULE: before choosing a carrier, read the aligned view and classify the FALSE edge's landing block as return / join / body. Do not port a carrier between sub-kinds; a carrier that is proven on one is evidence of nothing on the other.

CLAUSE 3 - VERIFY THE CARRIER AGAINST AN IN-TU ORACLE FIRST WHEN ONE EXISTS. The census tool promoted with this law finds byte-exact functions carrying the shape, and an oracle in the SAME TU is worth more than a cross-TU one because it holds the per-Object cflags fixed. game/sys/memcard's own `InitPreferences` is byte-exact and carries the pattern at 0x80069648; its source contains `gameOpts.data[2] = (OSGetSoundMode() == 0) ? 0 : 1;` - a ternary assigned to a memory destination. Cross-TU, `__CARDSetDiskID` (dolphin/card/CARDBios, byte-exact) carries it from `__CARDBlock[n].diskID = id ? id : &__CARDDiskNone;`. Both are ternaries whose RESULT IS STORED, which is a fourth sub-kind distinct from both above and is why neither transfers directly to a flag-guard site.

COROLLARY ON COUNT ACCOUNTING, worth as much as the carrier rule: a fused `bcc` is one word where the target has two, so a correct carrier ADDS an instruction. If the function is already long elsewhere, closing this cluster moves `real`, count-distance and fuzzy the WRONG way while the opcode multiset moves the right way - exactly what writeGauntletSave did (7t -> 4t but fuzzy 91.80 -> 91.36, count 191 -> 192 against T190). Do not read that as a failed carrier; read the aligned view, confirm the region now matches, and account for the remaining excess before deciding whether the carrier can be banked yet.
